title: Survey Findings Mind Map
subject: Economics
caption: Mind map of key consumer survey insights
altText: A mind map diagram with the central node titled Consumer Survey Insights. Branches extend to Suppression of Demand (with sub‑nodes Causes → Price Hikes, Supply Constraints and Effects → Reduced Purchases), Increased Confidence (Indicators → Employment Gains, Income Growth), New Routines (Online Shopping, Sustainability Focus), Pent‑up Demand (Potential Surge, Timing Uncertain) and Future Outlook (Growth Forecast, Policy Implications).
